evidence_class: MECHANISM / NEGATIVE-capable; development reading; not a capability claim
question: route and ctx are two different channels of the same effect; does either of them carry a deployment-visible pattern that total hides, and does selecting the treatment on that pattern beat choosing one treatment for everybody?

feature_sources.mechanism_9: audit_r4a_pattern_identifiability.mechanism_features; gap_period_aligned is excluded, as it is in R4A, because the definition is degenerate on a 48-step horizon
feature_sources.serving_action_conditions_6: audit_r4c_imputation_donor_conditions.serving_observables; meaningful for W2, computed for ANCESTOR only as a reference column since the ancestor does not run period_median_complete

rows.repeated_measures: the same uid recurs at every position of its block; rows are not independent and no significance is claimed

definitions.route: L_pr - L_rr, the shared-model channel (loss units)
definitions.ctx: L_pp - L_pr, this series' own serving-context channel
definitions.total: route + ctx = L_pp - L_rr = -g in the library convention
definitions.ctx_restriction: rows with |ctx| <= 1e-12 are dropped from the ctx channel: their serving window was not modified, so ctx is exactly zero by construction
definitions.auc: Mann-Whitney U with average ranks; each LODO fold is oriented by the sign the training blocks give
definitions.deployment_utility: mean over the whole served population of the fold of (-total if the rule selects the series else 0); identity is the L_rr arm and scores exactly 0

verdict_rules.PATTERN_INFORMATIVE: some quantity has every LODO fold >= 0.70 with one direction across folds
verdict_rules.PATTERN_WEAK: best LODO mean in [0.60, 0.70), or the folds disagree on direction
verdict_rules.SELECTION_BEATS_FIXED: at least 3 of 4 folds beat both always-P and always-identity and the smaller of the two mean margins is >= 0.005

ANCESTOR|route|delayed_face.verdict_reason: best LODO mean 0.579399 is below 0.60, but the folds disagree on sign, which the frozen rule reads as WEAK

ANCESTOR|route|both_faces.verdict_reason: best LODO mean 0.534267 is below 0.60, but the folds disagree on sign, which the frozen rule reads as WEAK

reading_4_r4a_crosscheck.rule: same best (feature|target) over R4A's 21 visible quantities and the same LODO mean to 5e-6
